title: One Browser - Video Downloader
summary: A file manager & web browser to mange files, navigate websites & download videos
description:
One Browser is a privacy-focused app with a built-in file manager, web browser, and video downloader. The app provides convenient file management features and safe web browsing. It also allows users to manage various file types. Users can delete unnecessary files, caches, and duplicates to free up valuable storage space.

What One Browser offers:
📥 Video Download Tool
One Browser lets you download videos easily. When a video is detected, a "Download" button appears allowing you to tap it and save the video directly to your device.
📂 Manage Files All in One
With a few clicks, you can easily search for and locate hidden files. It can organize a variety of file types, which include movies, audio files, documents, ZIP archives, APK files, and more. You may easily browse your storage and rename or move files and folders.
🧹Storage Cleaner
To free up storage space, the app can delete the log or log files, cache, temporary files, duplicate files, extensions, and hidden files. This helpful function allows you to easily manage and optimize the storage on your device.
📽Incognito Mode
The Incognito mode in OneBrowser shields you from dangerous websites. The majority of third-party cookies are also blocked. By doing this, your private data will be protected from unwanted access.
🔎 Multiple Search Engines
Select/Choose the search engine you want to use. Google, DuckDuckGo, Yahoo, and Bing are among the search engines that the Incognito Browser supports.
🎦 Full-featured Video Player
Swipe to adjust volume, brightness, and progress. The app has a floating movie player for multitasking and simple casting to a larger screen.

💡 Features 💡  
- Upgraded Web Browsing Experience
- All-in-One File Manager
-  Storage Cleaner
- Storage Cleaner
- Incognito mode
- Private bookmarks
- High-speed video downloader
- Automatic Video Detection
- Built-in Video Player
- Floating Video player
- User-Friendly Interface
- Multi playback option: auto-rotation, aspect-ratio, screen-lock, etc

One Browser offers seamless web browsing and the ability to view various file types. Users can easily navigate the internet and manage videos, audio files, documents, ZIP archives, and more. Upgrade your web browsing experience today!
